title: A full service description silently refuses Return and Space: no counter shows the 1,000 character cap

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread)

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/spaces/booking-service-types-form.tsx put maxLength={1000} on the service description Textarea with no counter, so at 1,000 characters Return and Space simply did nothing and the owner had no idea why. The server matches the cap: cleanServiceInput in lib/spaces/booking.ts slices the description to 1,000 characters; the space_service_types.description column is plain text with no check constraint. The cap stays at 1,000 so the client and the server agree.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: the form now reads the cap from one DESCRIPTION_MAX constant, shows a live "N of 1,000" counter under the field (aria-live, tied to the Textarea with aria-describedby), and when full adds the line "You've hit the limit. Trim a little to keep typing." Probe scripts/probes/service-description-counter.mjs fails on the prior tree and passes here; it also fails if the client cap drifts from the server slice.
